reasoning_content:
Domain routing works: urbankit.de -> /de (portal), app.urbankit.de -> /dashboard. Let's fetch /de to confirm 200 and content.

Also check hocuspocus logs and web logs for errors.

action.command: cd /workspace && curl -sS -m 30 -o /tmp/portal.html -w 'HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n' -L -H 'Host: urbankit.de' http://localhost:3020/; grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/portal.html | head; echo ---; curl -sS -m 30 -o /tmp/dash.html -w 'HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n' -L -H 'Host: app.urbankit.de' http://localhost:3020/; echo ---; docker compose logs --tail=20 web hocuspocus

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && curl -sS -m 30 -o /tmp/portal.html -w 'HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\\n' -L -H 'Host: urbankit.de' http://localhost:3020/; grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/portal.html | head; echo ---; curl -sS -m 30 -o /tmp/dash.html -w 'HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\\n' -L -H 'Host: app.urbankit.de' http://localhost:3020/; echo ---; docker compose logs --tail=20 web hocuspocus", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Fetch pages and view logs"}
